about: Every SSPG variable sorted into input / optimisation / fixed / dependent. 'cad_variables' are the 113 variables SSPG writes to CADs/SSPG/sspg_equations_onshape.txt, in that order; 'code_only' are values the code uses but does not write to the CAD file; 'unused_config_blocks' are config blocks SSPG never reads. tests/test_variable_categories.py checks the lists against the code, re-evaluates every formula and lookup, and docs/variables/sspg.md is generated from this file (python tools/variables/render.py).

categories.input: chosen parts: the motor's dimensions and the motor driver's mount dimensions
categories.optimisation: chosen by the optimiser: teeth, module, number of planets, and the gear face widths (set from the motor torque for each design)
categories.fixed: constants that don't depend on the design: clearances, wall thicknesses, fastener and bearing choices, feature sizes, the gear standard
categories.dependent: computed from the variables above, by a formula or a catalogue lookup (bearings, bolts, nuts)

confidence.high: the code reads it directly from one source, or computes it with an explicit formula
confidence.medium: the code is clear, but the category is a judgement call (see the reason)
confidence.low: can't be decided from the code alone

cad_variables.name: bearing_mount_thickness
cad_variables.formula: output_mounting_hole_dia * 2 if bearing_OD + output_mounting_hole_dia * 4 > Nr * module + 2 * h_b else ((Nr * module + 2 * h_b) - (bearing_OD + output_mounting_hole_dia * 4)) / 2 + output_mounting_hole_dia * 2 + standard_clearance_1_5mm
cad_variables.reason: two-case rule: a fixed wall when the bearing is wider than the ring gear, otherwise wide enough to cover the ring gear; the factors 2 and 4 are hard-coded

code_only.name: maxGearboxDiameter
code_only.formula: (MAX_GB_DIA_MULT_FACTOR_SMALL_MOTOR if motor_OD < SMALL_MOTOR_DIA_MM else MAX_GB_DIA_MULT_FACTOR) * motor_OD - 2 * ringRadialWidthMM
code_only.reason: largest gear diameter the optimiser may use (gearbox_runner max_diameter)

code_only.name: actuator_width
code_only.formula: motor_height + case_mounting_surface_height + standard_clearance_1_5mm + base_plate_thickness + case_dist + bearing_height + standard_clearance_1_5mm + fw_r + clearance_planet + bearing_retainer_thickness
code_only.reason: axial width without the driver mount, written to the results CSV
